title: When the Semester Falls
author: Noor Okafor
blurb: August Voss, the eldest sibling raising the younger ones while mom works nights, counts days until graduation like a sentence being served. Then the school's legendary ghost starts leaving notes addressed by name — in impossible ink — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must save the tradition that made the town, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
